correctness.rationale: For the stated support radius \(r_\varepsilon=k+\varepsilon(1-q\cos(\theta-m))\), monotonicity of the cosine on the active interval makes the endpoint value \(r=1/2\) the first curvature-feasibility obstruction and keeps the complementary curvature radius nonnegative throughout the slice. The source's area functional reduces to a quadratic \(C_0+C_1\varepsilon+C_2\varepsilon^2\). Fresh independent evaluation gives \(C_2=-0.002656771865422791<0\) and endpoint derivative \(0.01650985384639112>0\); since the derivative is decreasing, area increases on the entire feasible interval. The independently evaluated endpoint area is \(0.7871835266964052\), compared with \(0.786215602719126\) at \(13/20\) and \(\pi/4\approx0.7853981633974483\). The package's exact rational interval certificate removes floating-point dependence.

limitations: Only the source slice with \(m=15/16\) is optimized; no global optimum over all reduced bodies or all source parameters is claimed.
